title: Damage Randomizer
description: This mod randomizes your inventory when you take damage.
body:
![Thumnail Art](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XhUS2A8y/images/096f0301e8db1835bff0fe9337db8240981f84f0.png)

---

This mod randomizes your inventory every time you take damage. There is no cooldown, and it does not randomize your offhand or armor slots.

Config options available:
- Enable/Disable the mod
- Enable/Disable Offhand Randomization (default: false)
- Blacklist for progression items, like ender pearls and blaze rods (default: all blacklisted)
